origin.description: Convert a character object to UTF-8, optionally composing it.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Text to convert. bytes are decoded as UTF-8.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: When true, compose the result to NFC.

origin.details: R also honors a declared encoding. A byte string marked UTF-8 is not re-decoded from latin1.

translation.description: A string is already Unicode. bytes are decoded as UTF-8.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Text to convert. bytes are decoded as UTF-8.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: When true, compose the result to NFC.

translation.details: Python strings have no encoding mark. Pass bytes when the input is raw UTF-8.
translation.example:
from utf8 import as_utf8
print(as_utf8("A\u030a", normalize=True))
